changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.report_document ADD CONSTRAINT ck_report_document_rules CHECK ((group_rules_json IS NULL AND group_rules_sha256 IS NULL) OR (group_rules_json IS NOT NULL AND group_rules_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND group_rules_sha256 IS NOT NULL))

ALTER TABLE clinlims.patient_report_release ADD CONSTRAINT ck_report_release_frozen_content CHECK ((frozen_content_json IS NULL AND frozen_content_sha256 IS NULL AND frozen_at IS NULL) OR (frozen_content_json IS NOT NULL AND frozen_content_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND frozen_content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND frozen_at IS NOT NULL AND member_scope_json IS NOT NULL))
